The '''Central Beach''' was the centrally-located [[Beach/Legends|beach]] on an [[Unidentified island (Lehon)|island]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]].<ref name="KOTOR" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> a [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] had crashed in the shore just off the beach. That year,<ref name="TEA" /> the former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and his allies landed on Lehon aboard the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'' at the beach.<ref name="KOTOR" />
